in_arabic.name: حفيظة

in_urdu.name: حفیظہ

in_urdu.long_meaning: حفیظہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو حفظ سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا معنی ہے اپنے آپ کو محفوظ رکھنے والی، یہ نام قرآن پاک کی سورہ النساء میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور یہ نام پاکستانی اور ہندوستانی مسلمانوں میں بہت پسند کیا جاتا ہے

data.cultural_impact: The name Hafeeza signifies a deep connection and commitment to Islamic traditions and values. In many Muslim communities, memorizing the entire Quran is a highly respected achievement, representing a significant investment of time, dedication, and discipline. Hafeeza is a name that evokes a sense of pride and admiration within these communities, as it symbolizes a mastery of one of the most important components of Islamic faith and practice.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Hafeeza is rooted in the Quran itself. Memorizing the Quran is considered a means of drawing closer to Allah, as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The one who recites ten verses [of the Quran] will be rewarded ten times." (Bukhari). Hafeeza's knowledge of the Quran is a powerful tool for self-improvement and spiritual growth, providing guidance, comfort, and inspiration. In the words of Imam Al-Ghazali, "The Quran is the sun which rises upon the reality of things, and casts its light upon all affairs." Hafeeza's profound knowledge of the Quran is a source of illumination, illuminating the path to Allah and providing a compass for navigating the complexities of life.
